enginesVendoredAt: NextGen, sha-identical with engines e4d3b10 (MD-1, #224; MD1-1 repaired R1, R2 and R3 as FINDINGS-crude C14 to C16). Re-vendored on this branch as 030b1c93, a cherry-pick of the shared vendor commit 41d88b9f; the foundation stood on b1f29251 (60ee266). This wave does not vendor.

plan.state: FOUNDATION: recon, structure, digest, eighteen graded fields, gates, scaffold and task files. No lesson, bank, panel or migration is written.
plan.thesis: Every property of a blend is computed on its own basis (gravity through specific gravity on volume, sulfur and the other per-mass properties on mass, viscosity through an index, yields on volume off the curve), and every least-cost recipe is a linear programme whose binding specifications, value of relief and infeasibility are answers in their own right.

tiers.beginner: THE ASSAY AND THE BLEND: crudeAssay gravity, bases, Refutas, curve, cuts, stability. Graded: API, sulfur wt%, vanadium ppm, a mass share, the CII, a cut yield.
tiers.intermediate: THE BLENDED BARREL AND WHAT IT IS WORTH: blendDistillationCurves, temperatureAtVolumePercent, cutYields on the blend, netbackValue. Graded: T50, two blend cut yields, gross, loss and netback per bbl.
tiers.advanced: THE LEAST-COST RECIPE (linear programming for the whole module): solveLP, optimiseBlend, propertyOfBlend, valueGiveaway, SPEC_TEMPLATES, rvpIndex. Graded: least total cost, two recipe volumes, relief on sulfur, RVP and RON.

digest.note: No section is history. Every repaired MD1-0 rule is taught as how the engine works; SECTION 27 states the three HELD items as limits. Every figure is invented and illustrative, and the preamble says so.

grading.grader: public.academy_submit_capstone reads expected, tol and the answer as numeric, so every graded field is a number the engine returns and no basis word, band or verdict is graded.
grading.tolerance: 5e-5 for all eighteen: the digest prints every computed figure to four decimals and a field is graded at half a unit in that place (gradeprecision.py 18 of 18). Wide against engine error (LP 1e-9 relative, relief within the oracle's two exact quotients) and narrow against every wrong route (discriminate closest miss 14 tolerances). One derivation: DECIMALS and TOLERANCE in crude_capstone.mjs.
grading.collisionRule: No graded value within its tolerance of the absolute value of any number token the digest prints (the go-live rule), and no two graded values within tolerance of each other.
grading.notGraded: Refutas viscosity (HELD C12), Watson K (HELD C13), valueGiveaway dollars (no oracle computes it), the marker differential (no oracle computes it), every basis word, band, stable verdict and status.

findings.R1: REPAIRED UPSTREAM in MD1-1 (C14): netbackValue names a cut with no yield in unyieldedCuts, keeps its yield null and reports complete false. The digest now prints it on the Kwale + Ebocha partial blend (SECTION 15).
findings.R2: REPAIRED UPSTREAM in MD1-1 (C15): propertyOfBlend returns null when a stream in the recipe lacks the property. SECTION 25 prints the skipped specification's achieved value as not formed.
findings.R3: REPAIRED UPSTREAM in MD1-1 (C16): the fallback message says 'SARA was not supplied for every crude' when some crudes carry it. SECTION 11 prints it.
findings.N1: API blends linearly on MASS (mass-weighted mean of API numbers equals the blend API to 1e-14): taught as a computed identity in SECTION 4; never modelled as a wrong route. The engine comment 'API gravity does not blend at all' could be softened; not a defect.
findings.N2: oracle_productblending's RVP relief quotients carry about 6e-5 of float noise (its rvp_index is a float); oracle_check requires the engine's relief between the two quotients and the two within twice the tolerance.
findings.N3: With no availability bound active the marginal barrel equals the average barrel (every spec row has a zero rhs); ONNE has none active, so marginal-versus-average is taught on APAPA, where butane is at its cap.
findings.N4: Sulfur blended on volume makes ONNE infeasible; discriminate prints it as NO RECIPE and never counts it toward the three numeric routes.

decisions: Refutas viscosity and Watson K are NOT graded although the brief lists them as natural candidates: they are FINDINGS HELD items C12 and C13 and the standing rules say held items are taught, never graded. Both are taught as stated limits (SECTIONS 8, 14, 27) with the other basis printed beside them.
Every graded field is a four-decimal figure at tolerance 5e-5 (TOLERANCE = 5 / 10^(DECIMALS + 1); 0.5 * 10 ** -4 is a hair under 5e-5 in floating point and failed gradeprecision).

The relief prompts ask for the value of relief 'at the margin', because one whole unit re-solved is a different number wherever the value of relief curves (sulfur and RVP); discriminate models the whole-unit reading as a wrong route.
The Expert capstone's alkylate tank is typed as 0 bbl so 'a typed zero read as unlimited' is a live wrong route (alkylate at 91.5 $/bbl enters the recipe when unlimited).
The gravity-screen thresholds, the API constants, the Refutas constants and the Rankine offset are not typed in the digest: each is read back from the engine (probes or inverse calls).
